title: Three-phase microenvironment modification by optimizing ionomer towards high-performance proton exchange membrane fuel cells
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,8555-8581
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00604J, Tutorial Review
Jie Li, Qianli Ma, Shuda Dong, Shuang Zhao, Bo Wang, Xiao Feng
This review summarizes proton, water, and oxygen transport in ionomers of PEMFCs and highlights design strategies to optimize the three-phase boundary, enhancing mass transport, performance, and future prospects.
